select CASE WHEN ISNULL(CURRENT_MONTH_END,'') = '' THEN '2023-01-01' ELSE CURRENT_MONTH_END END start_date FROM EDS.DATE_DIM EDD 
	WHERE EDD.FULLDATE = DATEADD(MM,1,(SELECT MAX(DATE_ID) DATE_ID FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_AGG))


SELECT DISTINCT CURRENT_MONTH_END FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE FULLDATE BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2024-01-01';


select * into d360.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_AGG_bu_20250314 from EDS.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_AGG

select * from d360.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_AGG_bu_20250314


IF NOT EXISTS(select * FROM EDS.DATE_DIM EDD WHERE EDD.FULLDATE = DATEADD(MM,1,(SELECT MAX(DATE_ID) DATE_ID FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_AGG)))
    BEGIN
        SELECT '2023-01-01' start_date
    END
ELSE
    BEGIN
        SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL(CURRENT_MONTH_END,'') = '' THEN '2023-01-01' ELSE CURRENT_MONTH_END END start_date FROM EDS.DATE_DIM EDD 
	    WHERE EDD.FULLDATE = DATEADD(MM,1,(SELECT MAX(DATE_ID) DATE_ID FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY_AGG))
    END



SELECT GREATEST(CONVERT(DATE,'1900-01-02'),CONVERT(DATE,'1900-01-03'))



SELECT * FROM EDS.DATE_DIM

SELECT A.ACID,A.BANK_ID,A.SCD_START_DATE, B.old_SCD_END_DATE, CASE WHEN EDD.FULLDATE IS NULL THEN B.new_SCD_END_DATE ELSE EDD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY END AS new_SCD_END_DATE
FROM eds.DEP_GAC a
inner join (
            select gac.ACID,gac.BANK_ID,gac.SCD_START_DATE, SCD_END_DATE old_SCD_END_DATE,
            LEAD(gac.SCD_START_DATE, 1 ,'9999-12-31') OVER (PARTITION BY ACID,BANK_ID  ORDER BY SCD_START_DATE) as new_SCD_END_DATE
            from EDS.DEP_GAC gac
			JOIN (SELECT GAM_ACID, GAM_BANK_ID, DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS, ACCT_OPN_DATE FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT WHERE SUBSTRING(GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09' AND DEL_FLG = 'N' AND DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'C') EDF ON GAC.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID AND GAC.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID 

			) b
            on a.ACID = b.ACID and a.BANK_ID = b.BANK_ID and a.SCD_START_DATE = b.SCD_START_DATE
JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM EDD ON B.new_SCD_END_DATE = EDD.FULLDATE
